# rauthy_auth_provider (Data Source)

Looks up an existing upstream authentication provider by name, for referring to a provider this configuration does not manage.

Rauthy does not enforce unique provider names, so a name shared by two providers is an error here rather than an arbitrary pick.

The upstream `client_secret` is deliberately not exposed. Rauthy does return it in the clear on a read, but a lookup of somebody else's provider has no use for it and writing it into this state file would only spread it further.

Requires the `AuthProviders:read` API key right.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Refer to an upstream provider this configuration does not manage.
# Rauthy does not enforce unique provider names; a name shared by two providers
# is an error here rather than an arbitrary pick.
data "rauthy_auth_provider" "corp" {
  name = "Example Corp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the provider to look up.

### Read-Only

- `authorization_endpoint` (String) The upstream's authorization endpoint.
- `client_id` (String) The client id Rauthy was issued by the upstream.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider is offered as a login option.
- `id` (String) Rauthy-assigned identifier of the provider.
- `issuer` (String) The upstream's issuer.
- `jwks_endpoint` (String) The upstream's JWKS endpoint, if it has one.
- `scopes` (Set of String) Scopes Rauthy requests from the upstream.
- `token_endpoint` (String) The upstream's token endpoint.
- `type` (String) Provider flavour: `custom`, `github`, `google` or `oidc`.
- `userinfo_endpoint` (String) The upstream's userinfo endpoint.
